title: Windows of Influence — Illustrator-derived relationship curve geometry
purpose: Provide Codex with exact authored relationship-trajectory geometry from Curve Data(1).svg so it does not reconstruct curve shapes with Catmull–Rom or other interpolation.

provenance.important: The 9 relationship trajectories are SVG-derived. The 2 stimulus trajectories are NOT contained in this SVG and are included only as separate current-database references.
provenance.diagnostic_colours: Illustrator source colours identify/reconstruct curves only; final webpage relationships should remain monochrome and stimuli blue.
provenance.source_geometry_integrity: All relationship anchors and cubic Bézier control points are extracted directly from the Illustrator SVG. Multi-fragment dashed curves retain their original fragment geometry. CRV-04 is explicitly represented as one shared trunk with two branches.

coordinate_system.baseline_tolerance_note: Several Illustrator anchors sit at y=318.97 rather than the axis y=318.68. Preserve source SVG coordinates for exact reproduction; when using normalised event semantics, clamp tiny negative influence values to 0.

rendering_contract_for_codex: Use the authored cubic Bézier segments in this file directly. Do NOT regenerate relationship shapes from relationship-event points.
Do NOT run Catmull–Rom, cardinal spline, monotone spline, smoothing, peak-radius heuristics, or support-point generation over these relationship geometries.
Scale/translate the authored geometry affinely into the webpage plot. An affine transform preserves the Illustrator curvature exactly.
Keep relationship events as a separate semantic layer. Events may place markers, labels, derive Windows of Influence, and later drive animation, but they do not define the static path shape.
Render exactly CRV-01 through CRV-09 as the nine relationship trajectories. Do not add property curves as extra trajectories.
CRV-04 is one addressable relationship with a shared trunk and two branches, A and B. Do not count the branches as extra relationship trajectories.
CRV-02 contains an early piece and a later re-emergent piece separated by an intentionally inactive/zero interval. Do not connect the gap with an invented line.
Source diagnostic colours are not the final relationship colours. Use final_style / website CSS for monochrome relationship styling.
Keep STC-01 and STC-02 as two separate blue stimulus trajectories. They are not part of the nine relationship count.
Complete and approve the static graph before adding animation.
